metadata.title: Implement Welcome Back Wizard Trigger and UI

story.iWant: to be greeted by a "Welcome Back" wizard when I return to the app after a long absence
story.soThat: I can easily get back on track with my study plan without feeling overwhelmed.
story.tasks: - Implement frontend logic to store and retrieve the date of last user activity (e.g., last login or interaction). - Implement frontend logic on login to compare last activity date with current date and check for overdue tasks. - Develop the "Welcome Back" wizard UI component. - Design the full-screen, non-judgmental modal with supportive messaging. - Implement initial display of overdue task count. - Integrate the wizard to conditionally replace the dashboard view. - Ensure the wizard handles cases where there are no overdue tasks despite a long absence (it should not be displayed).

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. On login, the frontend checks the date of the user's last activity (AC3 from Tech Spec). 2. If the last activity exceeds a defined threshold (e.g., 3 days) and there are overdue tasks, the "Welcome Back" wizard is displayed instead of the standard dashboard. 3. The wizard presents a user-friendly UI as described in the UX spec, with supportive messaging ("Welcome back! Life happens. Let's get you back on track.").

constraint.description: The "Welcome Back" wizard must trigger only under specific conditions: a defined long absence (e.g., >3 days) AND the presence of overdue tasks.
The wizard must be full-screen, non-judgmental, present supportive messaging, and offer clear, simple choices for rescheduling overdue tasks.
The trigger logic on login should be fast and efficient, not causing significant delays to the initial dashboard load time.
Access to user activity data and overdue task information must be secure and comply with privacy policies.
The count of overdue tasks displayed in the wizard must be accurate and reflect the current state of the user's plan.

tests.standards: Unit Tests: Test frontend logic for storing/retrieving last activity date, calculating absence duration, and accurately detecting overdue tasks. Component Tests: Test the `WelcomeBackWizard` UI component in isolation, verifying its presentation, supportive messaging, and initial display of overdue task count under different scenarios. E2E Tests: Simulate user login after a long absence with varying numbers of overdue tasks to verify the wizard appears correctly. Also, test scenarios where the wizard should NOT appear (e.g., recent login, no overdue tasks). UX/Usability Testing: Validate the non-judgmental tone, clarity of options, and overall user experience of the wizard as per UX design specifications.

ideas.idea: Unit test: Verify last activity date is correctly stored and retrieved from local storage or user session.
Unit test: Verify the wizard's trigger condition (e.g., >3 days absence AND overdue tasks) is met/not met correctly.
Component test: Verify the `WelcomeBackWizard` UI displays the correct overdue task count and supportive message.
E2E test: Simulate a user logging in after a 5-day absence with 10 overdue tasks and verify the wizard appears.
E2E test: Simulate a user logging in after a 1-day absence with overdue tasks and verify the wizard does NOT appear, and the dashboard is shown.
